description: CLI parity proof for the shared Agent Session transaction. A validated v2 JSON profile is staged in a clean portable install, --launch-load-agent arms one deferred activation, and the ordinary production boundary validates and commits campaign state before applying preferences, social identity, and presence. Agent Select uses the same transaction; the separate agent_select_json_load_smoke drives that menu path directly.

input_sequence.comment: The parser captures name='smoke' and saveInit establishes the portable profile store before the deferred tick. Once lvframenum reaches 4, bootLaunchLoadAgentTick calls agentSessionActivate('smoke'), the same transaction used by Agent Select.
Allow a clean install to finish typed-asset extraction and catalog admission, then exit after the deferred shared activation has produced its save and Agent Session receipts.

required_lines: SAVEMIGRATE: Initialized \(0 migrations registered, current save version: 2\)
SAVE: Agent Profile activation committed name='smoke'.*source=migrated-v2

required_counts.pattern: SAVE: Agent Profile activation committed name='smoke'.*source=migrated-v2
